title: Social feed page
description: GET /api/social/feed 200: one page of the public home feed, the same for every caller. Pinned presales come first (latest pin first, one latest public post per sale); remaining items rank by occurred_at_ms plus the active-why and big boosts, descending, then entry_id descending. No viewer-specific field.

oneOf.description: Opaque. Pass back unchanged as cursor for the next page.
